name: genai-eval
description: Design and qualify a GenAI evaluation as a measurement instrument. Ships two skills. eval-design names the decision, defines a falsifiable construct, builds a contamination-controlled item pool, and seals an eval-card.json; a stdlib-only validator (check_eval_card.py) holds that card to six mechanical gates (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 9). eval-qualify measures judge-human agreement with bootstrap confidence intervals read against the human-human ceiling, judge bias probes for length, position, self-preference and prompt sensitivity, a power check against a stated minimum detectable effect, and an observed disagreement taxonomy — all on a stdlib-only statistics toolkit — running standalone on a CSV of judge scores and human labels. What remains: eval-qualify has no card mode and there is no qualification block, so Gates 6, 7, 8, 10 and 11 are not computed by anything that ships yet.
